name: dotnet-studio
description: The Visual Studio workflow in VS Code and VSCodium: Solution Explorer, NuGet, Test Explorer, Error List, Run & Debug, Configuration Manager, Publish.

enumDescriptions: Show Solution Explorer in the left sidebar (Sidebar)
Show Solution Explorer in the right sidebar (Secondary Sidebar)
shinobi.solutionExplorer.location.description: Choose where the Solution Explorer appears

enumDescriptions: No nesting: every file shows in its folder
Visual Studio's default rules: code-behind (Index.cshtml.cs), designer files, configuration variants (appsettings.Development.json), resources
The default rules plus web assets: compiled, minified and map files under their source (site.ts > site.js > site.min.js)
shinobi.solutionExplorer.fileNesting.markdownDescription: How files nest under related files, like the File Nesting button in Visual Studio's Solution Explorer.

shinobi.solutionExplorer.trackActiveItem.markdownDescription: Select the active editor's file in the Solution Explorer whenever you switch files, like Visual Studio's *Track Active Item in Solution Explorer*. Without it, use *Sync with Active Document* (`Ctrl+[, S`).

shinobi.solution.offerSlnxConversion.markdownDescription: When a `.sln` opens, offer to convert it to `.slnx`, the current solution format (*Don't Ask Again* turns it off for one solution).

shinobi.diagnostics.showErrors.description: Show errors in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Errors toggle)

shinobi.diagnostics.showWarnings.description: Show warnings in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Warnings toggle)

shinobi.diagnostics.showInfos.description: Show infos and suggestions (the ··· hints in the editor, Visual Studio's "Messages") in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Messages toggle)

shinobi.solutionExplorer.diagnostics.sho.description: Also mark infos and suggestions (the ··· hints in the editor, Visual Studio's "Messages") in the Solution Explorer; errors and warnings are always marked
shinobi.solutionExplorer.diagnostics.sho.deprecationMessage: Use shinobi.diagnostics.showInfos, which the Error List toggles share with the Solution Explorer.
shinobi.solutionExplorer.diagnostics.sho.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#shinobi.diagnostics.showInfos#`, which the Error List toggles share with the Solution Explorer.

shinobi.debug.checkDevCertificate.markdownDescription: When a project with an `https://` launch profile starts (F5, Ctrl+F5, Start New Instance, startup profiles), check once per session whether the HTTPS development certificate is trusted and offer to trust it. Off: nothing is checked. *Trust HTTPS Development Certificate* in the command palette works either way.

shinobi.build.emitGeneratedFiles.markdownDescription: Builds started by this extension write what source generators produce (`EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles`), so *Dependencies > Analyzers* can show it. Off: builds write nothing extra and generators show no files.

enumDescriptions: Apply the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to suggestion, warning or error
Apply the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to warning or error
Apply only the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to error
shinobi.codeCleanup.severity.markdownDescription: Which code style rules of the `.editorconfig` Code Cleanup fixes, by the severity the rule has there (`dotnet format style --severity`).

shinobi.tests.discoverAfterBuild.markdownDescription: Discover tests again after every build, so the Test Explorer stays current. Off (for very large solutions): use the Test Explorer's refresh button.

shinobi.nuget.includePrerelease.markdownDescription: Open the NuGet Package Manager with *Include prerelease* checked.

target.description: Absolute path of the solution or project file

configuration.description: Build configuration (Debug, Release, ...); the active solution configuration when not set
